SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   B. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

   D. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

16. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   C. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   D. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Culture and Social Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain School and Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
